headlines.description: Yokohama F. Marinos eased past title rivals FC Tokyo 3-0 on Saturday to clinch their first J-League trophy since 2004.
headlines.shortLinkText: Postecoglou's Yokohama beat rivals Tokyo to secure J-League title
